description: This file defines a template class 'EnumerateType' and related macros for handling enumerations with string conversion capabilities, including methods for comparison, assignment, and lookup. It also declares a struct 'EnumerateConversion' for mapping enum values to string names.

classes.name: EnumerateType
classes.description: A template class that manages enumeration values with string conversion, comparison, and assignment functionalities.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying enumeration value from another EnumerateType.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for moving enumeration value from another EnumerateType.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for assigning an enumeration value directly.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for assigning a uint32_t value.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Template assignment operator for assigning from a Core::TextFragment with case sensitivity option.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Template assignment operator for assigning from a TCHAR string with case sensitivity option.

methods.name: Assignment
methods.description: Assigns an enumeration value based on case sensitivity and string input.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the enumeration value is set.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the current enumeration value.

methods.name: operator const TCHAR*
methods.description: Converts the enumeration value to its string name.

methods.name: Entry
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the enumeration conversion table at a given index.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds the enumeration conversion entry matching a string or value.
